name: podium-mars-room
brief: Five Mars College residents are holding a demo night in Chiba, the auditorium. Everyone meets in Chiba and finds a seat on the tiers or the sofas; then each, in the agreed order, steps up to the presenter box at the front, by the projector table, and gives one short talk about their project, while the rest listen.

podium.label: the presenter box at the front of Chiba, by the projector table

seats.character: Ines builds the solar rigs on campus; brisk, practical, and the host of tonight's demo night. She opens it.
seats.topic: how a tired battery bank taught her to love load schedules, and a welcome

seats.character: Kofi cooks for everyone in the Chiba kitchen; generous, loud laugh, measures nothing and gets it right anyway.
seats.topic: feeding forty people from one stock pot

seats.character: Rue grows things in the desert against all advice; patient, wry, with dirt under her nails.
seats.topic: the one plant that survived the summer and why

seats.character: Sami spends nights in the Tool camp building a small walking robot; shy until the robot comes up, then unstoppable.
Theo DJs at Freeside and records the desert at night; mellow, a little mysterious, closes the evening.
seats.topic: the sound of the playa at three in the morning
